title: Retrospective Analyses of TrakStar Database
official: Retrospective Analyses Evaluating the Real-World Effectiveness of NeuroStar® TMS and the Factors Associated With Clinical Outcomes
summary: In this study, real-world data will be used to better understand the effects patient characteristics, symptoms and TMS protocol parameters have on clinical outcomes with NeuroStar TMS.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female reported in database and not an invalid entry
* Age reported and not an invalid entry
* Treatment date of November 01, 2008 or later.

Exclusion Criteria:

• Incomplete information on treatment parameters
